title: Repeat rules
text: Daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly with an interval, weekdays, and monthly positions.

title: Ends your way
text: Never, after a number of occurrences, or on a date.

title: Readable summary
text: A plain-language summary and a preview of the next occurrences.

title: Standard rules
text: Values are recurrence rules that convert to and from the iCalendar RRULE format.
